source_note: 把积分或求和对象视为一个计数函数并展开
english_source_note: Treating Sums or Integrals as Counting Functions
callout_id: 把积分或求和对象视为一个计数函数并展开#4
english_title: Example 3.1: A Proof of Legendre's Formula for the Exponent
statement_en:
Using the viewpoint of this note, prove Legendre's formula for the exponent of a prime $p$ in $n!$: $$
u_p(n!)=\sum_{k\geq 1}\left\lfloor rac{n}{p^k}ightfloor.$$ The argument starts from $$
u_p(n!)=\sum_{m=1}^n 
u_p(m)$$ and rewrites $$
u_p(m)=\sum_{k\geq 1}1_{p^k\mid m}.$$
key_techniques: rewrite valuation as a counting function
callout_body:
在[[从二项式系数到Kummer定理#1. Legendre公式]]当中我们介绍了计算阶乘$n!$素因子$p$指数的办法$$
u_p(n!)=\sum_{k\geq 1}\left\lfloor rac{n}{p^k}ightfloor$$我们可以试着从本篇文章当中的观点中来证明这件事。我们利用$$
u_p(r_1r_2)=
u_p(r_1)+
u_p(r_2)$$的这种性质。那么$$
u_p(n!)=\sum_{m=1}^n 
u_p(m)$$其中我们把$
u_p(m)$视为一个计数函数，即$$
u_p(m)=\sum_{k\geq 1}1_{p^k|m}$$从而带入到$
u_p(n!)$的式子当中，并交换求和次序，从而得到$$
u_p(n!)=\sum_{m=1}^n \sum_{k\geq 1}1_{p^k|m}= \sum_{k\geq 1}\sum_{m=1}^n1_{p^k|m}=\sum_{k\geq 1}\left\lfloor  rac{n}{p^k} ightfloor$$这便是Legendre公式。
